tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urine analysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), marked leukocyturia, positive nitrites, and presence of blood, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. Glucosuria is noted without ketonuria, which may warrant further evaluation for glycemic control. No casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
